title: Dry-end relevance-bounded adaptive representation
question: Can the F-AHL10B conductivity refinement be completed without wasting support in the previously qualified negligible-storage dry tail, while preserving authoritative hydraulics through analytical fallback outside the represented domain?

dry_end_policy.historical_numerical_context: Earlier O05 work used C_J=max(C,dt*1e-13) as a Newton-Jacobian regularization; this work does not conflate that timestep-dependent floor with the raw-C representation stop.
dry_end_policy.tail_semantics: No constitutive truncation. Heads drier than the material-specific represented-domain bound use the authoritative analytical provider.

material_specific_rule: If C crosses 1e-13 inside the nominal domain, use that head as the dry lookup-domain boundary; otherwise retain the nominal -1e6 cm boundary.
stable_construction_oracle: -expm1(m*log1p(-u)) for the Mualem bracket, as qualified by F-AHL10C
acceptance: all four materials build successfully at each tested tolerance
tails are routed to analytical fallback rather than constant extrapolation
frozen F-AHL10 Richards gates are not changed
